4D.7 When you make a vow unto God, you shall not delay to pay it, for God will require you to keep your word.

precepts.text: Iniquities prevail against me; as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
precepts.point: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me. Israel is afflicted because of sin, but the affliction has not prevailed, because we have been in and out of captivity through repentance.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

precepts.why: “Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.” Iniquities prevail, but the affliction has not: “yet they have not prevailed against me.” The Most High purges our transgressions away, and that is why we have been in and out of captivity through repentance.

points: Praise waits for the Most High in Zion and the vow shall be performed; He hears prayer and unto Him shall all flesh come.

note.label: Psalm 65: Thou Crownest the Year With Thy Goodness

points: Iniquities prevail, but He purges away the transgressions; blessed is the man He chooses and causes to approach to dwell in His courts, satisfied with the goodness of His house and holy temple.

note.label: Psalm 65: Thou Crownest the Year With Thy Goodness

points: By terrible things in righteousness He answers as the God of salvation, the confidence of all the ends of the earth and of them far off upon the sea.

note.label: Psalm 65: Thou Crownest the Year With Thy Goodness

points: By His strength He sets the mountains and stills the noise of the seas and the tumult of the people; they that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid of His tokens, and He makes the outgoings of morning and evening rejoice.

note.label: Psalm 65: Thou Crownest the Year With Thy Goodness

points: He visits the earth and waters it, greatly enriching it with the river of God which is full of water, and He prepares corn, waters the ridges and settles the furrows.

note.label: Psalm 65: Thou Crownest the Year With Thy Goodness

points: He crowns the year with His goodness and His paths drop fatness; the pastures are clothed with flocks, the valleys covered over with corn, and they shout for joy and sing.
